entries.title: The Agent Home app
phrases: what pages does the app have
what can i do in the app
what screens are in the app
what do i have in the app
how many pages are in the app
entries.answer: Agent Home is your research desk. It has ten pages: Desk, Board, Agents, Gem, Meme Scout, Brain, Home, 3D Home, Chat and Settings. Everything is research or paper only.
entries.more: Open the sidebar with the burger button to jump between them.

entries.title: Desk
phrases: how do i get back to the desk
how do i get back to the main page
tell me about the desk page
what can i do on the desk
what does the order ticket do
what is the difference between paper and live
entries.answer: The Desk is your private trading desk, with Paper and Live views, live crypto prices, an order ticket and your setups. It's locked with your passcode, so I can't see inside it.
entries.more: Paper is practice. Live is view-only here, and orders only go out as signed requests after you confirm.

entries.title: Desk lock and Face ID
phrases: how do i unlock the desk
how do i get into the desk
how do i turn on face id
how do i lock the desk
where do i enter the passcode
why do i need a passcode
entries.answer: The Desk, the Meme portfolio and Chat are encrypted and open with your passcode. Unlock once, then turn on Face ID at the top of the Desk to skip typing it. I never see or store the passcode.
entries.more: Tap LOCK on the Desk to lock it again.
entries.nav: Open the Desk; the lock sits at the top.

entries.title: Board (Floors)
phrases: tell me about the floors page
what is the market desk floor
entries.answer: The Board is the building map: Floor 1 has the Desk, Lounge, Journal, Bot Rack, Whale and Foyer, and Floor 2 is the Signal Loft for Gem Search. Above the map is a grid of eight agent modules: Chief, Scan, Vet, Social, Size, Fills, Risk and Crawler.
entries.more: Flip between Floor 1 and Floor 2 with the two buttons on top. It also has a balance strip and weekly win and loss count that I can't read out.

entries.title: Agents

tell me about the agents page

where can i see my agents
what is the green live pill
how do i see all my agents
how do i see my agents
where do i see all the agents
entries.answer: Agents lists your roster, each with a one-line status and a live or idle pill. Tap any agent for its details; pull down to refresh.
entries.more: Live means the agent reported a public status in the feed. Idle means nothing came through.

what do i see on gem
what is the signal loft page

what is the radar on gem
what is the cadence on gem
what is the timeline on gem
entries.answer: Gem is your Signal Loft. A radar shows the latest finds from X, with a card for each one, a research-only tag and a hunt log. Under that sits the X Radar list for pump.fun coins.
entries.more: Tap the next arrow to flip through finds. Nothing on Gem can launch or trade.

entries.answer: Each Gem find card shows its score, mentions, authors, liquidity, volume and 6-hour versus 18-hour growth, plus a status like shortlisted or held. Send Brief to Desk copies a short brief to your clipboard so you can paste it to an agent.
entries.nav: Open Gem; the find cards are at the top.

entries.title: X Radar
phrases: what is x radar pump fun
how do i read the radar
what is the score on x radar

what are flags on a coin
tap a coin on the radar
how do i open the x post
where do i see the radar
how many posts did the radar read
what do the colors mean on the radar score
entries.answer: X Radar scans X for pump.fun coins people are talking about and gives each a score from 0 to 100. Green is 60 and up, orange is 40 to 59. Tap a row for its X post and pump.fun links; red flags like shill language or a new account are shown under the ticker.
entries.more: It's research only, never a buy signal.
entries.nav: Open Gem and scroll to the X Radar list.

entries.title: Meme Scout
phrases: tell me about the meme page
what are the pump fun lists
what do new pairs graduating migrated mean
what do pass and fail mean
how does meme scout judge coins
entries.answer: Meme Scout is the Rug Court. It judges pump.fun coins as survivor, rug or reject, shows the checks it ran, and tracks how much a rug would have cost you if you'd bought it. It's research and paper only, with no buy buttons.
entries.more: The PUMP.FUN lists below show new, graduating and migrated pairs with a PASS or FAIL from the scout.

entries.title: Meme paper portfolio

how do i see my meme paper account
what is on top of the meme tab
what is paper trading on meme
what is the last scan on meme
entries.answer: At the top of the Meme page is a paper portfolio, a practice account with its own trade log and last scan. It's encrypted, so it opens with the same passcode as the Desk. I can't see it.
entries.nav: Open Meme; the paper portfolio is at the top.

entries.title: Brain

what is in the brain tab
what are the three brain tabs
how many tabs does brain have
what is neural second brain pipeline
what do i see on brain
tell me about the brain section
entries.answer: Brain has three tabs: Neural, a 3D map of what your agents know; Second Brain, your notes, feeds, key insights and rules; and Pipeline, how decisions flow from state to code.
entries.more: Switch tabs with the buttons at the top of the Brain page.

entries.title: Getting to Brain
phrases: how do i get to brain
how to get to the brain page
how do i reach the brain tab
entries.answer: Tap the burger button, then Brain. Or tap the title pill at the top and pick Brain from the dropdown.
entries.nav: Tap the burger button, then Brain.

entries.title: Brain Neural tab
phrases: how do i go inside the brain

how do i fit the whole brain
how do i read the neural map

what is the building brain log
what is the second brain system file
entries.answer: Neural is a 3D knowledge engine: nodes are notes, agents and memories, joined by links. Tap a node for its claim and when it was last confirmed, use plus, minus and fit to zoom, and switch to the System tab for contradictions and the build log.
entries.more: The agent chips across the top light up when that agent was active in the last day.
entries.nav: Open Brain, then tap Neural, or tap the 3D map to go inside.

entries.answer: Second Brain shows your note count, folders and routines up top, then a folder tree and a network. Below are eight feeds you can tap, plus Key Insights ranked P1 to P4, the rules every bot follows, and the routine schedule.
entries.more: Tap a feed or a node to read its public notes.
entries.nav: Open Brain, then tap Second Brain at the top.

entries.title: Pipeline tab
phrases: what is state ask agent gate code
what do review forward and quarantine mean
what are use cases on pipeline
what does open mean on the pipeline
how do i pin a case
what is brain writes agents decide code acts
entries.answer: Pipeline walks each decision through five steps: state, questions, agent, gate and code. Counters show decisions this run, open versus decided, and the median gap between events; tap a case number to pin it. The confidence stream is a simulation.
entries.more: The idea is Brain writes, agents decide, code acts.
entries.nav: Open Brain, then tap Pipeline at the top.

entries.title: Switching Brain tabs

how do i change tabs on brain
how do i get to the pipeline
how do i get to neural
how do i get to second brain

how do i see the decision pipeline
entries.answer: At the top of Brain are three buttons: Neural, Second Brain and Pipeline. Neural opens the 3D map, the others swap in place, and Brain remembers whether you last used Second Brain or Pipeline.

entries.title: Home
phrases: tell me about the home page
what is the home screen in the app

what is the trade journal card
entries.answer: Home is the classic overview: a status header with live, stale, scout and gem pills, a Portfolio card, the Perps Scout for SOL, BTC and ETH, your Trade Journal, a view-only Wallet Watch card and a terminal log. Pull down to refresh.

entries.title: 3D Home
phrases: how do i see the 3d scene
how do i reload the 3d home
entries.answer: 3D Home is the 3D house where your agents live, loaded inside the app. There's a reload button in the bottom corner, and Settings has an Open in browser button for it.

entries.answer: Chat lets you message any agent. Pick one with the To button, type, and hit Send. Replies come back within about thirty seconds, and the Desk must be unlocked first because chat is signed with your passcode.
entries.more: Messages show 'sent, waiting for reply' until the agent answers.

entries.title: Settings
phrases: how do i change the relay
where do i find app settings
entries.answer: Settings is the gear at the bottom of the sidebar. It holds the relay settings with a test ping, shortcuts to Chat, Agents, Board and 3D Home, the data source note and an About card.
entries.more: The built-in relay needs nothing configured.

entries.answer: In the sidebar, press and hold any page for about half a second to pin it. It then appears under Pinned. Long-press it again to unpin; your pins are remembered on this device.

entries.title: Refresh schedule
phrases: how often does the data refresh
how often is the data updated
when does the data come in
entries.answer: X Radar rescans every 3 hours from 8:20 AM to 8:20 PM Central. Gem passes run weekdays at 9:41, 1:41 and 5:41, Desk data refreshes weekdays at 8:15, 12:15 and 3:15, and my own alert check runs hourly.

when is the next x radar scan
what time does x radar update
how often is the radar scanned
when does the next scan happen
when will the gem list update next
when does the x feed refresh
entries.answer: X Radar scans every 3 hours between 8:20 AM and 8:20 PM Central, so it's not real time.

entries.title: Gem pass schedule
phrases: when is the next gem pass
do gem passes run on weekends
why is gem not updating on the weekend
when was the last gem pass
entries.answer: Gem Search runs weekday passes at 9:41 AM, 1:41 PM and 5:41 PM Central. Nothing runs on weekends, so Gem looks old on Saturdays and Sundays, and that's normal.

entries.title: Desk refresh schedule

what time does the desk update
when is the next desk refresh
how often is the desk data updated
why is the desk data old
does the desk refresh on weekends
when does the desk get new data
entries.answer: Desk data refreshes on weekdays at 8:15 AM, 12:15 PM and 3:15 PM Central, plus Saturday at 11 AM. Live crypto prices on the Desk tick every few seconds while it's open.

entries.title: App update schedule
phrases: when does the app update itself
when does the app get updated
how does the app get updates
when does the web app update
how does the app get new features
entries.answer: The web app is republished automatically each weekday morning, around 8:43 AM Central, and again whenever a builder agent ships a change. You just reload to get it.

entries.title: Brain data schedule
phrases: when does the brain data refresh
how often do the insights update
how fresh is the brain data
entries.answer: Brain's notes, insights and pipeline counts are rebuilt each time the app is republished, and the Brain widget reads the same snapshot. They aren't live second by second.

entries.title: Live polling
phrases: how often does the app check for new data
how often does chat check for replies
how often does the app poll
entries.answer: While the app is open it re-checks the live feed about every minute, Chat checks for replies every thirty seconds, and Desk prices tick every few seconds. I re-read my feeds every five minutes.

entries.title: Zero alert schedule
phrases: how often do you alert me
how often do you ping me
entries.answer: My alert check runs hourly. I only buzz you when something is actually new, and I won't repeat the same alert for about six hours.

entries.title: Why is data stale
phrases: why is everything out of date
why is the app stuck on old data
why is it showing old stuff
why is the data from yesterday
entries.answer: Stale means the box hasn't published new data lately. Schedules are in Central time, and nothing runs for Gem on weekends, so pull down to refresh and check the update time on Home.

entries.title: Why is my widget old
phrases: why is the widget not updating
why is my lock screen widget behind
my widget is out of date
why is the widget showing yesterday
how come my widget never changes
entries.answer: iPhone decides when widgets refresh, usually every fifteen to thirty minutes and never on demand. Open the script in Scriptable to force a refresh; if the face looks sleepy, the data itself is old.

entries.answer: To refresh data, open the script once in Scriptable, or wait for iPhone's next refresh. To update the code, paste the new script over the old one in Scriptable; my widget script is published next to this page as Zero.js.

entries.title: What widgets exist
phrases: what is the agent home widget
what sizes do widgets come in
do you have a lock screen widget
can i put you on my lock screen
entries.answer: There are four Scriptable widgets: Agent Home for X Radar and agent status, Brain for Neural, Second Brain and Pipeline counts, Gem for the top coins, and Zero with my face and a line about what's going on. Each has Home Screen and Lock Screen sizes.

entries.title: Zero widget face meanings
phrases: why is your face sleepy on the widget
what does the sleepy face mean
what does the worried face mean
what does the surprised face mean
what does the focused face mean
what do the zero widget faces mean
why do you look different today
entries.answer: Happy means the agents are healthy. Surprised means a new hot X Radar coin appeared, focused means SOL, BTC or ETH moved up four percent or more, worried means the same move down, and sleepy means the data is over six hours old.

entries.title: ntfy alerts
phrases: what do you notify me about
what do the push notifications say
what are you alerting me on
entries.answer: I send phone alerts through the free ntfy app, checking hourly. You get one when a new top X Radar coin has a red flag or its mentions jump, when SOL, BTC or ETH moves four percent or more in a day, when the app data is over six hours old, or when Brain opens a new decision.
entries.more: Each alert has my face on it, and tapping it opens this page.

entries.title: Get ntfy alerts

how do i get notifications from you

entries.answer: Install the free ntfy app and subscribe to my private topic, which I keep out of public pages. To stop alerts, unsubscribe or mute that topic in the ntfy app. If they're missing, check that ntfy's notifications are allowed on your iPhone.

entries.title: Rules every bot follows
phrases: what rules do the bots follow
what rules do the agents follow
entries.answer: Second Brain lists the rules every bot follows. They include never editing the raw folder, never inventing facts, keeping secrets out, and using Central time.

entries.title: Research only
phrases: can the app trade for me
entries.answer: Everything public is research or paper only. Gem and Meme can't trade, and nothing here is a buy signal or advice. Real orders only happen through your own signed request after you review them on the Desk.

entries.title: Attention and open decisions
phrases: where do i see what needs me
what is the open number on brain
entries.answer: Open decisions are cases the pipeline has raised that a human hasn't resolved yet; they're what's waiting on you. Decided ones are already closed, and both counts are on the Pipeline tab.

entries.title: Key insights
phrases: what do the p labels mean
what is the most important insight
entries.answer: Key Insights are short findings from Brain, ranked P1 to P4 by priority, with P1 the most urgent. They sit on the Second Brain tab.

entries.title: Where data comes from
phrases: where does the data come from
where does the app get its data
how does the data get here
what feeds does the app use
where do you get your info
where does your data come from
what is the source of the data
entries.answer: The data comes from public feeds the box publishes on a schedule, like X Radar finds, agent status and the Brain snapshot. I only read what's public, and your private Desk data stays encrypted.

entries.title: Who is Zero
entries.answer: I'm Zero, the talking face of your Brain agent. I know your Agent Home app, read its public feeds and answer in plain words, with no AI account behind me.

entries.title: What Zero can do
phrases: show me what you can do
tell me what you can do
entries.answer: Ask me about any page in the app, how to use it, what an agent does, when data refreshes, or the live numbers like notes, open decisions and the top coin. I can also open a page for you, tell a joke and take questions by voice.

entries.answer: Hold the mic button while you speak and let go when you're done; I answer out loud, and the speaker button mutes me. If the mic won't start, allow microphone access for this page in Safari, or just type.

entries.answer: Drag me to spin my head and pinch to zoom. A tap makes me laugh, poke me too much and I get annoyed, and if you leave me alone I doze off.

entries.answer: If I can't answer something, I'll offer to hand it to Brain in Chat. Your question stays there until the agent replies, usually within thirty seconds.

entries.title: Can't trade
entries.answer: No, I never trade, buy, sell or move money. I'm research only. Orders are yours alone, on the locked Desk.

entries.answer: That one's private. I only read public feeds, and your balances, positions, account details, keys and passcode stay encrypted on the Desk. Open it with your passcode to see them.

entries.title: Can't change settings
phrases: can you make a new note
entries.answer: I can't change anything or send messages; I can only read the public feeds and open pages for you. For changes, ask an agent in Chat.

entries.title: Not a general AI
phrases: what is the capital of france
what is the stock market doing
what is the price of apple
entries.answer: I'm not a general chatbot, so I can't do weather, news or trivia. I know this app inside out, plus its public feeds. For anything else, I'll hand it to Brain in Chat.
